The verifiers in scripts/replay_fqcd_lean.py and scripts/replay_pr492_lean.py accept a migrated pin only when removing added_text from the current file reproduces replayed_sha256 exactly, and added_text consists solely of whole lean_lib stanzas whose library names and module roots do not overlap a replayed library or module namespace. A fresh replay supersedes these entries.
